messages.subject: WITHOUT PREJUDICE - Brampton v Hartwell - mediation
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sarah,

Without prejudice. Further to the CMC, our client is prepared to mediate. We suggest a one-day mediation in September after exchange of witness statements but before expert reports, with a view to narrowing the gap. Would your client agree in principle, and do you have a preferred mediator?

Kind regards,
Olivia

messages.subject: RE: WITHOUT PREJUDICE - Brampton v Hartwell - mediation
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Olivia,

Without prejudice. Our client is willing to mediate and has been from the outset. We'd prefer to mediate after expert reports are exchanged, when both sides will have a clearer view, but we're open to an earlier date if your client is serious about engaging on quantum. We'd suggest one of the construction mediators at the usual panel - happy to exchange names.

Sarah
